description: Property names differing only in normalization are two dynamic attributes
notes: The spec says attribute names are unique within a body and that strings are equal when their NFC normalizations are, but doesn't say whether attribute names compare as strings; the native syntax says identifiers aren't normalized. hashicorp/hcl compares property names byte for byte ((*body).JustAttributes in json/structure.go), so the precomposed and decomposed names are two attributes. The input spells them with the precomposed U+00E9 and with an e followed by U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT.
